draft.body:
Dear Kestrel Byte Hosting Ltd accounts team,

We have received a request to change your bank details for invoice KBH-88412. Before acting on it, please confirm whether this request came from you.

Please confirm by phone on the number we already have for you, or by replying from your usual email address. We will not act on this request until we hear back from you.

Thank you,
Ashgrove Bakery
